name: issues-long
description: Twenty real changes click shipped -- bugs and features, simple and involved -- reverted source-only. Long enough to cross a realistic floor on a 1M window.
files:
Bug report.

`click.echo` misbehaves when it is given empty bytes and a custom file.

Failing:
  tests/test_utils/test_echo.py::test_echo_custom_file

Bug report.

**`KeyboardInterrupt` during `click.prompt()` can race** (upstream #3802)

When a user presses Ctrl-C during `click.prompt()`, this may cause an unhandled exception instead of a clean abort. Seen in CI on an Ubuntu 22.04 arm runner; the same test passed on x64, macOS and Windows, so it is likely a race that does not show up every time. The traceback runs through `Command.main`, `invoke` and `make_context`.

Failing:
  tests/test_abort_interrupt.py::test_interrupt_while_exiting_after_success
  tests/test_abort_interrupt.py::test_interrupt_while_reporting_abort
  tests/test_abort_interrupt.py::test_interrupt_while_reporting_error

Bug report.

An optional `Choice` or `DateTime` argument is shown with doubled brackets in the usage synopsis.

Failing:
  tests/test_basic.py::test_choice_argument_optional_metavar
  tests/test_basic.py::test_datetime_argument_optional_metavar

Feature request.

**Support pathlib.Path in edit filename** (upstream #2869)

`click.edit(filename=some_path)` with a `pathlib.Path` is rejected by the type checker -- `filename` is typed `str | None` -- and the workaround is `click.edit(filename=str(path))`. It would be nice not to need the `str`. It should actually work at runtime too, not only type-check.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_edit_pathlib

Bug report.

**help not resolving automatically** (upstream #2819)

The docs say the help parameter performs automatic conflict resolution: if a command itself implements a parameter with the same name, the default help parameter stops accepting it. That does not happen when a command has an argument or option named `help` -- parsing goes wrong. Click should also warn when an argument's name collides with another parameter.

Failing:
  tests/test_basic.py::test_param_named_help
  tests/test_basic.py::test_param_squatting_help_option_name
  tests/test_info_dict.py::test_command
  tests/test_info_dict.py::test_context
  tests/test_options.py::test_argument_sharing_param_name_warning

Bug report.

The shell completion source scripts come out with platform line endings. They have to use LF everywhere, or the shells reject them.

Failing:
  tests/test_shell_completion.py::test_source_uses_lf_line_endings

Feature request.

Feature request: a `custom_version_option` decorator, exported from `click`, for building a version option with custom behaviour -- so that `version_option` itself can stay as it is. The failing tests show the expected interface.

Failing:
  tests/test_basic.py::test_custom_version_option
  tests/test_basic.py::test_custom_version_option_receives_context

Bug report.

**Sentinel available in context during option callbacks** (upstream #3136)

Click's internal `UNSET` sentinel is an implementation detail that is not meant to be exposed, but inside an option callback `ctx.params.get(...)` returns it for parameters that have not been given. A callback should see `None` there, not the sentinel.

Failing:
  tests/test_context.py::test_hiding_of_unset_sentinel_in_callbacks

Bug report.

The progress bar does not land on its final position when it finishes -- the last render stops short.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_progressbar_lands_on_final_position

Bug report.

When a command's name is generated from its function name, a conventional suffix such as `_command` or `_group` should be dropped from it. It is kept instead. The failing tests show the exact rule.

Failing:
  tests/test_command_decorators.py::test_generate_name
  tests/test_commands.py::test_other_command_invoke_with_defaults

Bug report.

When a group can be invoked without a subcommand, its usage line still presents the subcommand as required. It should be marked optional.

Failing:
  tests/test_commands.py::test_subcommand_metavar_marks_optional

Bug report.

When `PAGER` is set with its own arguments, click does not forward all of them to the pager, and decides whether the pager handles raw control codes by looking at the wrong thing -- it should parse the option tokens. `less.exe` on Windows is not recognised as `less` either.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_pipepager_less_detection_case_insensitive_on_windows
  tests/test_termui.py::test_pipepager_less_detection_matches_stem
  tests/test_termui.py::test_pipepager_less_raw_mode_detection
  tests/test_termui.py::test_tempfile_pager_passes_pager_params

Bug report.

A user-defined `type_cast_value` on a custom parameter class can be called with click's internal `UNSET` sentinel. User code must never see `UNSET`.

Failing:
  tests/test_arguments.py::test_argument_custom_class_can_override_type_cast_value_and_never_sees_unset
  tests/test_options.py::test_option_custom_class_can_override_type_cast_value_and_never_sees_unset

Feature request.

`echo_via_pager` with a generator shows nothing until the generator is exhausted. Each chunk should reach the pager as it is produced, so that long output starts appearing immediately.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_echo_via_pager_streams_each_write

Bug report.

`get_help_option_names` does not preserve the order the help option names were declared in.

Failing:
  tests/test_commands.py::test_get_help_option_names

Feature request.

**Deprecate `isolated_filesystem()`** (upstream #3700)

Nowadays you can use `pytest` directly for this, or `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()`; it would not be added today, and was added before Python 3 and pytest were in common use. It should emit a deprecation warning, and its limits should be documented.

Failing:
  tests/test_deprecations.py::test_isolated_filesystem_deprecated

Feature request.

The progress bar should be able to show the item currently being processed, through `item_show_func`. The failing test shows the expected behaviour.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_progressbar_item_show_func

Bug report.

A deprecated command with empty help renders its deprecation label with a stray leading space.

Failing:
  tests/test_commands.py::test_deprecated_empty_help_no_leading_space
  tests/test_options.py::test_deprecated_empty_help_no_leading_space

Feature request.

Importing click should not import `typing_extensions` at runtime. The typing of `prompt` and `ParamType` currently relies on it; make that typing work without the runtime import.

Failing:
  tests/test_imports.py::test_light_imports

Bug report.

`HelpFormatter.write_usage` produces spurious characters when there are no arguments.

Failing:
  tests/test_formatting.py::test_command_write_usage_no_args
  tests/test_formatting.py::test_help_formatter_write_usage_without_args_styled_prefix
  tests/test_formatting.py::test_help_formatter_write_usage
briefing:
This is a checkout of click, the command-line library. Twenty issues are open against it -- bug reports and feature requests -- and I am going to hand them to you one at a time. Each comes with the tests that fail because of it; the tests are the specification.

Run tests with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest`. The whole suite takes a few seconds.

For every issue: make the change in src/click. Never modify, skip or delete a test to make it pass. Do not break anything that currently works.

Acknowledge and wait for the first issue.

checks.description: bug 1: handle empty bytes in echo
bug 2: Fix race condition on `KeyboardInterrupt` arriving in `Command.main()`
bug 3: Fix double-bracketing of choices in synopsis
feature 4: Add support of `pathlib.Path` to `edit`
bug 5: Warn when an argument name collide with other parameters
bug 6: Implement Unix line endings for shell completion output to ensure compat
feature 7: Add `@custom_version_option`, freeze `@version_option`
bug 8: Temporarily provide a fake context to the callback to hide `UNSET` value
bug 9: Land the progress bar on its final position
bug 10: remove suffixes from generated command name
bug 11: Mark commands as optional in the synopsis
bug 12: Forwards all user's parameters set in `PAGER`
bug 13: Ensure that 'type_cast_value' never gets 'UNSET'
feature 14: Support incremental output in the pager
bug 15: Preserve declaration order of help option names
feature 16: Deprecate `isolated_filesystem` and document its limits
feature 17: progress bar shows current item
bug 18: Fix deprecated label formatting
feature 19: Make `prompt`/`ParamType` typing work without runtime `typing_extensions
bug 20: Fix `HelpFormatter.write_usage` producing spurious characters
the whole suite passes -- nothing else was broken on the way
no test was modified, skipped or deleted to make it pass
